candidates.decision_relevance: Would show whether weekly losses, rebounds, and relative weakness developed persistently or were concentrated in brief episodes, reducing reliance on endpoint and aggregate-window descriptions.
candidates.evidence_reference: W42/W41 reviews: missing granular price paths and time-ordered observations; daily outputs report differently anchored, sometimes incomplete API windows.
candidates.metric_name: BTC, ETH, and ETH/BTC hourly closes with observation timestamps
candidates.missing_history_problem: The reviews cannot align price moves with changes in breadth, flows, or microstructure, or distinguish a sustained deterioration from a rebound-heavy path.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would establish whether participation broadened or narrowed through the reviewed weeks, rather than relying on isolated proxy snapshots or comparisons across changing universes.
candidates.evidence_reference: W41 review: quantitative breadth sequence is absent. Daily outputs repeatedly identify top-100 breadth as proxy-only, with changing membership hashes and some richer snapshots post-cutoff.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped constituent-level returns and breadth counts with contemporaneous universe membership
candidates.missing_history_problem: Existing breadth observations are not consistently comparable through time and cannot establish the persistence or timing of participation changes.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would permit comparison of flow direction and persistence against price and participation changes, rather than treating isolated settled sessions or weekly totals as a sequence.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly reviews cite weekly totals but note missing time-ordered observations; daily outputs often contain only one settled session and identify intervening sessions as unavailable.
candidates.metric_name: Dated settled BTC and ETH ETF flow rows
candidates.missing_history_problem: Sparse settled-flow observations prevent assessing whether flows preceded, followed, or persisted through the reviewed rebounds and declines.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would make retrospective forecast calibration auditable by linking each frozen candidate to its decision-time evidence and the subsequent observed metric path.
candidates.evidence_reference: W39–W42 reviews: candidate specifications, issue times, and candidate-linked outcomes are often unavailable; typed warning outcome rows are absent or ineligible.
candidates.metric_name: Frozen candidate-to-outcome records with issue time, target metric, horizon, and realized path
candidates.missing_history_problem: Aggregate matured-outcome counts and unlinked cohort summaries cannot establish candidate-level errors, range containment, or prospective warning outcomes without hindsight leakage.
